metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Sindh province, Pakistan increase in September 21, 2020 compared to September 21, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-1 SAR (good for water detection, all-weather) or Landsat 8 (optical, good NDVI/MNDWI for water) - I'll use Sentinel-1 VV polarization with ascending orbit, as water has low backscatter - Alternatively, use Landsat 8 with NDMI (Normalized Difference Moisture Index) or MNDWI (Modified Normalized Difference Water Index) - Dates: September 21, 2019 and September 21, 2020 - Location: Sindh province, Pakistan (coordinates roughly 24-27°N, 67-72°E) - Use a bounding box or polygon for Sindh 2. Masking strategy: - For Sentinel-1: No cloud masking needed (radar is all-weather) - For Landsat 8: Apply cloud mask using BQA or QA_PIXEL - Detect water: Sentinel-1 uses low VV backscatter (< -10 dB typically) - Or Landsat: MNDWI > 0.3 or NDMI > 0.3 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Compare water extent (pixel count or area) between the two dates - If either date has 0 images → C1 - If both have images but 0 valid water pixels after masking → Could be C2 or B (no water) - If calculation returns None/NaN → C3 - If 2020 water extent > 2019 → A (Yes, increase) - If 2020 water extent ≤ 2019 → B (No, no increase) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Sindh province, Pakistan bounding box const sindh = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([66.5, 23.8, 72.5, 27.5]); // Dates: September 21, 2019 and 2020 const date1Start = '2019-09-20'; const date1End = '2019-09-22'; const date2Start = '2020-09-20'; const date2End = '2020-09-22'; // Function to detect water using Landsat 8 MNDWI function detectWater(img) { const green = img.select('B3'); const swir1 = img.select('B6'); const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('MNDWI'); const water = mndwi.gt(0.3).rename('water'); return water; } // Function to mask clouds using QA_PIXEL function maskClouds(img) { const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(cloudMask); } // Collect and process 2019 images const col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(sindh) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .map(maskClouds); const count2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); print('2019 Images found: ' + count2019); if (count2019 === 0) { print('No images for 2019-09-21.'); print('C1'); return; } // Collect and process 2020 images const col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(sindh) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .map(maskClouds); const count2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); print('2020 Images found: ' + count2020); if (count2020 === 0) { print('No images for 2020-09-21.'); print('C1'); return; } // Mosaic and detect water for 2019 const water2019 = col2019.map(detectWater).mosaic(); const waterPixels2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sindh, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); print('Water pixels 2019: ' + waterPixels2019); // Mosaic and detect water for 2020 const water2020 = col2020.map(detectWater).mosaic(); const waterPixels2020 = water2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: sindh, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('water').getInfo(); print('Water pixels 2020: ' + waterPixels2020); // Validate results if (waterPixels2019 === null || waterPixels2020 === null) { print('C3'); return; } if (waterPixels2019 === 0 && waterPixels2020 === 0) { print('No water detected either year.'); print('B'); return; } // Compare water extent const increase = waterPixels2020 > waterPixels2019; const percentChange = ((waterPixels2020 - waterPixels2019) / waterPixels2019 * 100).toFixed(1); print('Change: ' + percentChange + '%'); if (increase) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
